thread:
noah: Tideway is ready to start the co-sell POC next Tue. They want a 7-day shared sandbox, SSO, and an offline HSM question. Can we confirm constraints and a minimal runbook?
ivy: Short answer: hosted POC supports BYOK via cloud KMS; full hardware HSM requires Redwood Private. For SSO we can do SAML or OIDC. Need ACS/redirect and team contact.
sam: Traffic profile from Tideway: median ~15 rps, short bursts to 180 rps. Recommend a dedicated 3-node staging pool with autoscale to 6 for bursts. We'll also enable prefix caching to reduce costs.
ops-oncall: Telemetry options: cross-account S3 export or a read-only role for their analytics. Default retention 45 days for POC. We'll mask PII at ingest. Also add a burst throttle: 300 req/min per tenant to protect the pool.
noah: Sales asked for a simple pricing stub for the partner. For POC: $1,500 credits + option to convert to a small reserved commit. Billing, can you draft a co-sell quote with a partner discount?
billing-ops: Will do. Need estimated token/hr and expected concurrency. If they convert to reserved, propose a 15% discount for first 60 days.
ivy: Security questionnaire flagged EU residency and export controls. Tell them eu-west-1 hosting is available; logs exported to their US lake require DPA addendum.
sam: Minimal curl test to validate routing (replace <TOKEN>):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-medium","input":"healthcheck","max_tokens":4}'
```
Expected quick reply: {"status":"succeeded","output":"ok"}
ops-oncall: I'll create the provisioning ticket and the cross-account role for telemetry. Also adding note: tenant-level service keys enabled for POC.
noah: Runbook call Wed 9am PT. Agenda: tenant provisioning, SSO handshake, telemetry export, pricing review. Ivy/sam/billing-ops please join.
billing-ops: Added. I'll attach draft quote before the call.
ops-oncall: Ticket created POC-7732 and assigned to sam.
noah: Action items: sam 5 provision staging pool + ticket, ivy 5 answer sec questionnaire + SSO config, billing-ops 5 draft co-sell quote. Sending partner invite now. :white_check_mark:
